## Validation

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes for browser engine changes.
- [ ] `python -m build` succeeds for packaging changes.
- [ ] Browser changes include a screenshot and `scripts/check_browser.py` result.
- [ ] Corpus changes follow `docs/corpus-extension.md` and update source hashes/provenance.
- [ ] Generated words are not presented as attested quotations.

## Compatibility

Describe changes to seeds, rules, package data, provenance schema, published atlas files, or reproducible outputs.
